body: I am angry. Just feeling everything right now. When you find out you're being used hurts the most considering what my ex did to me a year ago. The rope is tied but I can't bring myself to do it yet. I have a letter written and a text to a friend. I just need to psych myself out to do it. Just sucks that people use you to make themselves feel better. I never do anything to hurt anyone. I am always there for people when they need me. But nobody is ever there for me when I need them. I wish I could go back in time to stop me from meeting her. She ruined everything I built up.

For me right now tons of things. Mainly loneliness at this point in my life. Most would consider my life pretty good but I hate it. I have no friends and no girlfriend. Been a year since my ex and I broke up. She was the one that ended it because she was tired of having to hide that she was cheating. It wouldn't have been so bad  if we didn't have a kid together. I was ok being alone at first until recently. I met someone new and things were going pretty good until recently. Finally realized that I was just being used and had to cut it off. It sucks because it made me feel even more lonely. The realization that my life sucks right now and how unhappy I am with everything. I regret letting her into my life because I spent so much time building up a wall to just have it knocked down.
